name: methylcellulose (4000 cps)
uses: USE(S) relieves occasional constipation to help restore and maintain regularity generally produces a bowel movement in 12-72 hours
otcwarn: ASK A DOCTOR BEFORE USE IF YOU HAVE abdominal pain, nausea or vomiting a sudden change in bowel habits that persists over a period of 2 weeks STOP USE AND ASK DOCTOR IF rectal bleeding occurs you fail to have a bowel movement after use These could be signs of a serious condition
